purpose: The essential operational path of PEE, stage by stage. tests/vertical_contract.test.ts fails if a named component disappears, a cited test file is missing, or a status is not one of the defined classes. Update this file in the same commit as any change to a stage's connection or status (principles 2 and 10).

statusClasses.authentic_verified: implemented and verified with authentic data on the operational path
statusClasses.synthetic_verified: implemented and verified only with synthetic data
statusClasses.disconnected: implemented but not reachable from the request path
statusClasses.blocked: implemented but blocked by missing authorisation or authentic evidence

stages.inputs: text; store; category registry; optional ranking context (signed catalog + pinned authority)
stages.evidence: Phase253 T2 real requests (16); reality-check frozen requests on authentic declarations

stages.responsibility: purchase target, category, needs (including performance objectives)
stages.inputs: text; store concept aliases (journaled category items)
stages.outputs: target, category + basis, need concepts with matched words
gates: explicit category name required before checking or ranking
stages.evidence: Phase253 T2; reality check 6/7 -> 7/7 targets; performance needs 1/3 (vocabulary gaps)

stages.responsibility: stated limits and performance needs as confirmed criteria
stages.inputs: text; recognised needs; catalog dimensions (for performance criteria)
stages.outputs: Phase177 snapshot: criteria confirmed with provenance user_request_statement
gates: only stated limits and stated needs are confirmed; inferences stay candidates
stages.evidence: Phase253 25/26 constraints; T3 QueryNER control; reality check 4/5

stages.outputs: eligible pool; factual checks (meets / fails / unknown)
gates: product lines excluded; identity warnings make products unknown
stages.evidence: 189 stored products; reality check shortlists on authentic declarations
missing: new-source discovery is blocked: no live acquisition authorised (Phase264 pilot halted; research policy permits no reads)

stages.responsibility: acquire and extract original test results
stages.evidence: synthetic only (Phase265, 11/11 scenarios); 0 authentic test documents; 3 authentic manufacturer pages give 0 leads (correct)
missing: authentic original test documents (owner rights decision)

stages.responsibility: exact product and variant for each observation
stages.inputs: page main product identity; lead subject
gates: exact identity only; never on similar names
stages.evidence: Phase265 tests (0 incorrect attribution on fixtures)

stages.responsibility: originality, method, conditions, exact variant, independence, uncertainty of each measurement
gates: independence never inferred from publisher type
missing: validator producing reviewed measurements from Phase265 rows (design: docs/phase267/ENGINEERING-CORRECTION-REPORT.md §F)

stages.responsibility: normalise compatible measurements and score them per criterion under a versioned policy
stages.outputs: Phase181 observations (valuePoints) per product and dimension
stages.evidence: none: valuePoints are supplied by a reviewer whom nothing provides
missing: catalog compiler and scoring policy (owner decisions)

stages.responsibility: deterministic order from reviewed, signed knowledge
stages.inputs: signed catalog; pinned authority keys; confirmed criteria
gates: Ed25519 signature by a pinned key
stages.evidence: connected to the request path 2026-10-16; synthetic signed catalog only; production disabled: no signed catalog exists (owner decision on review and signing authority)
missing: an authorised producer of signed catalogs

stages.responsibility: cited recommendation or justified abstention, with unassessed objectives explicit
stages.evidence: ranked answers synthetic only; specification answers on authentic declarations

surfaces.note: ranks only from configured signed data (Phase180/181); never reads the knowledge store or calls adviseFromRequest253

openDebt.item: no promotion path from observations to reviewed knowledge
no producer of reviewed valuePoints / signed catalogs
web surface disconnected from the store-backed path
